units.source_text: 内大臣声言即将出门。

en.t: The Inner Minister announced that he was about to go out.

units.source_text: 走出房间，却偷偷地钻进了他所宠爱的一个侍女房中，

en.t: He left the room, but secretly slipped into the chamber of one of his favorite serving women,

units.source_text: 和她密谈了一会，又缩紧了身子悄悄地溜出去。

en.t: spoke with her privately for a while, then hunched himself up and quietly slipped out again.

units.source_text: 半途上听见有人在暗处窃窃私语，觉得奇怪，倾耳一听，原来是侍女们正在议论他。

en.t: On the way he heard people whispering in the dark; finding it strange, he listened closely and realized that the serving women were talking about him.

units.source_text: 但闻一人说：“他自己以为贤明，但世间父母总是糊涂的。

en.t: He heard one of them say, "He thinks himself wise, but parents in this world are always foolish.

units.source_text: 你瞧吧，不久就会出毛病。

en.t: Just watch; before long something will go wrong.

units.source_text: 常言道：‘知子莫若父。’这句话其实是瞎说。”

en.t: People say, 'No one knows a child better than the father,' but that saying is really nonsense."

units.source_text: 她们在讥笑他。

en.t: They were mocking him.

units.source_text: 内大臣想道：“原来真有这般丑事，果然不出所料！

en.t: The Inner Minister thought, "So there really is such a scandal; it is just as I expected!

units.source_text: 我以前并非不提防到，但念两个都还是孩子，就疏忽了。

en.t: It is not that I failed to guard against it before, but because I thought they were both still children, I let my vigilance slip.

units.source_text: 世事真难办啊！”

en.t: How difficult worldly affairs are to manage!"

units.source_text: 他这才明白了情况。

en.t: Only then did he understand the situation.

units.source_text: 但并不声张，悄悄地出去了。

en.t: But he did not make a fuss and quietly went out.

units.source_text: 前驱者簇拥大臣登车后，高声喝道。

en.t: After the attendants in front escorted the Minister into his carriage, they called out loudly.

units.source_text: 侍女们相与言道：“咦，老爷到这时候才动身呢。

en.t: The serving women said to one another, "Oh, the master is only leaving now.

units.source_text: 不知道他躲在什么地方。

en.t: Who knows where he was hiding?

units.source_text: 到了这年纪还要偷偷摸摸。”

en.t: At his age, he still has to sneak around."

units.source_text: 适才议论他的两个侍女说道：“刚才飘来一阵浓烈的衣香，我们还道是夕雾少爷走过，原来是老爷！

en.t: The two serving women who had been talking about him said, "A moment ago a strong scent from someone's robes drifted by, and we thought young Lord Yugiri had passed, but it was the master!

units.source_text: 啊呀，糟糕！

en.t: Oh no, this is terrible!

units.source_text: 我们刚才说的话恐怕被他听到了！

en.t: He probably heard what we were just saying!

units.source_text: 这位老爷脾气很暴躁呢。”

en.t: This master has a very violent temper."

units.source_text: 大家不免担心。

en.t: Everyone could not help feeling worried.
